"""Fresh final-prefix and old/new legacy-extractor corpus differential.

An exact unchanged tokenizer cleaning prelude proves that a row with no
differing grouped/decimal candidate cannot reach the changed condition. Every
possible candidate executes the exact current legacy extractor with a pure
old/current guard observer. Divergent decisions execute the original old
extractor; no divergence proves identical old/current state and inventory. The en-US
route has identical reachable AST. All rows freshly execute the final actual
recall prefix/helper, and changed inventories are streamed with exact deltas.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import collections
import copy
import dataclasses
import functools
import json
import multiprocessing
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import differential as d
from guard_observer import make_observer

OLD_VALIDATOR = "a21d67a4d1f82b56c1641c4bdc311091a2e2ecc368a893ff0ad8be6ed963a007"
NEW_VALIDATOR = "0e8cf1e5d63e400d5303453b3f242d528524ac5ae63b8d67e70013fee208c2e3"
FINAL_SOURCE = "bf1694e95de7dbe7813c31ec2098bfcf2f315d0c02d6bdbe1bdab693edb71d6b"
FINAL_METADATA = "a1bf6df0a0f1559a56f334e20fb78e07e13588aa3a5eef979f85d89573fef321"
CURRENT_MAIN = "c2ee166fd1813392022fe5cf4c1e08ae1f09aba0"


def numeric_proof(old_bytes, new_bytes):
    old_text, new_text = old_bytes.decode(), new_bytes.decode()
    added = (
        "            source_span = cleaned_view.source_span(span)\n"
        "            # Prefer a grouped reading only when this same source token\n"
        "            # supplied it. An unrelated integer (such as a retained page\n"
        "            # number) cannot disambiguate an operative decimal amount.\n"
    )
    conjunct = (
        "                    occurrence.span == source_span\n"
        "                    and math.isclose(\n"
    )
    assert new_text.count(added) == new_text.count(conjunct) == 1
    reverted = new_text.replace(added, "").replace(conjunct, "                    math.isclose(\n")
    assert reverted == old_text, "Numeric changes exceed the reviewed source-span condition"
    old_defs = d.definitions(old_bytes)
    route = "_tokenize_profiled_numeric_occurrences"
    profiled = d.reachable(old_defs, route)
    assert "_tokenize_numeric_occurrences_from_text" not in profiled
    start = new_text.index("def _tokenize_numeric_occurrences_from_text(")
    end = new_text.index("\ndef extract_typed_numeric_inventory_occurrences_from_text(", start)
    current = ast.parse(new_text[start:end]).body[0]
    previous = old_defs["_tokenize_numeric_occurrences_from_text"]
    endpoint = next(index for index, node in enumerate(current.body) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef))
    assert ast.dump(ast.Module(body=current.body[:endpoint], type_ignores=[]), include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(ast.Module(body=previous.body[:endpoint], type_ignores=[]), include_attributes=False)
    # The text used by the changed condition is established in this prelude
    # and is never reassigned in the rest of the tokenizer.
    for node in current.body[endpoint:]:
        for child in ast.walk(node):
            if isinstance(child, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign, ast.AugAssign)):
                targets = child.targets if isinstance(child, ast.Assign) else [child.target]
                assert not any(isinstance(name, ast.Name) and name.id in {"cleaned", "cleaned_view"} for target in targets for name in ast.walk(target))
    probe = ast.parse(ast.unparse(current)).body[0]
    probe.name = "_audit_legacy_condition_has_candidate"
    # Backward dataflow slice of the exact unchanged prelude: keep only
    # statements required for the cleaned text inspected by this conservative
    # probe. Unused collector/context creation does not alter cleaned text.
    required = {"cleaned"}
    retained, removed = [], []
    for statement in reversed(current.body[:endpoint]):
        if isinstance(statement, ast.Assign):
            targets = {n.id for t in statement.targets for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n, ast.Name)}
            if not targets.intersection(required):
                removed.append(ast.unparse(statement).split("=", 1)[0].strip())
                continue
            required.difference_update(targets)
            required.update(n.id for n in ast.walk(statement.value) if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and isinstance(n.ctx, ast.Load))
        retained.append(copy.deepcopy(statement))
    retained.reverse()
    # The tracked-text constructor is a plain dataclass. This assignment
    # leaves .text identical and recomposes only .offsets, unused by the probe.
    tracked = old_defs["_TrackedText"]
    assert isinstance(tracked, ast.ClassDef)
    assert not any(isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in {"__init__", "__post_init__"} for n in tracked.body)
    offset_recomposition = [n for n in retained if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and len(n.targets) == 1 and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name) and n.targets[0].id == "cleaned_tracked" and isinstance(n.value, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.value.func, ast.Name) and n.value.func.id == "_TrackedText"]
    assert len(offset_recomposition) == 1
    assignment = offset_recomposition[0]
    assert ast.unparse(assignment.value.args[0]) == "cleaned_tracked.text"
    retained.remove(assignment)
    assert not any(isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and n.attr == "offsets" for node in retained for n in ast.walk(node))
    probe.body = retained + ast.parse("""
for match in SOURCE_TEXT_NUMBER_PATTERN.finditer(cleaned):
    raw = match.group(1).replace(',', '')
    try:
        value = float(raw)
    except ValueError:
        continue
    grouped_value = _parse_belgian_numeric_phrase(match.group(1))
    if grouped_value is not None and not math.isclose(grouped_value, value, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=NUMERIC_GROUNDING_ABS_TOLERANCE):
        return True
return False
""").body
    generated = ast.unparse(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[probe], type_ignores=[])))
    return {
        "only_legacy_source_span_conjunct_and_its_assignment_differ": True,
        "entire_validator_bytes_identical_after_reverting_exact_reviewed_guard": True,
        "entire_validator_ast_identical_after_reverting_exact_reviewed_guard": True,
        "unchanged_en_us_route_and_reachable_declarations": sorted(profiled),
        "unchanged_en_us_route_excludes_changed_legacy_tokenizer": True,
        "unchanged_en_us_route_ast_sha256": d.sha(json.dumps(profiled, sort_keys=True).encode()),
        "cleaning_prelude_old_new_ast_identical": True,
        "candidate_probe_unused_prelude_assignments_removed_by_backward_dataflow": removed,
        "candidate_probe_omits_plain_dataclass_offset_recomposition_preserving_exact_text": True,
        "cleaned_text_never_reassigned_before_the_changed_condition": True,
        "exact_generated_candidate_probe_sha256": d.sha(generated.encode()),
        "candidate_probe_is_conservative": "It scans the exact unchanged cleaned text with the actual number pattern, parser and tolerance; it deliberately ignores earlier skip conditions, allowing false positives but no skipped potential condition change.",
    }, generated


def current_source_proof(previous, sources, metadata):
    old = json.loads((previous / "summary.json").read_bytes())
    bridge_dir = d.HERE / "final-byte-bridge"
    bridge_summary = json.loads((bridge_dir / "summary.json").read_bytes())
    assert d.sha(sources["final"]) == FINAL_SOURCE
    bridge_source = (bridge_dir / "final-source.py").read_bytes()
    assert d.sha(bridge_source) == bridge_summary["source_sha256"]["final"]
    assert bridge_summary["metadata_sha256"]["final"] == d.sha(metadata["final"]) == FINAL_METADATA
    assert bridge_summary["previous_complete_summary_sha256"] == d.sha((previous / "summary.json").read_bytes())
    assert bridge_summary["validator_sha256"] == OLD_VALIDATOR
    old_main = (previous / "main-source.py").read_bytes()
    current_main = sources["main"]
    old_defs, current_defs = d.definitions(old_main), d.definitions(current_main)
    reachable = d.reachable(old_defs, "authoritative_numeric_recall_text")
    assert reachable == d.reachable(current_defs, "authoritative_numeric_recall_text"), "Current main recall changed"
    imports = lambda content: [ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False) for node in ast.parse(content).body if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom))]
    assert imports(old_main) == imports(current_main)
    previous_final = d.reachable(d.definitions(bridge_source), "authoritative_numeric_recall_text")
    current_final = d.reachable(d.definitions(sources["final"]), "authoritative_numeric_recall_text")
    assert previous_final == current_final, "Current final recall differs from its completed source bridge"
    assert imports(bridge_source) == imports(sources["final"])
    return {
        "original_three_snapshot_shared_recall_proof": json.loads((previous / "pipeline-proof.json").read_bytes()),
        "original_to_current_source_shared_recall_proof": json.loads((bridge_dir / "pipeline-proof.json").read_bytes()),
        "static_source_proofs_reused_only_after_exact_source_metadata_and_previous_summary_hash_checks": True,
        "original_pipeline_proof_sha256": d.sha((previous / "pipeline-proof.json").read_bytes()),
        "source_bridge_pipeline_proof_sha256": d.sha((bridge_dir / "pipeline-proof.json").read_bytes()),
        "source_bridge_summary_sha256": d.sha((bridge_dir / "summary.json").read_bytes()),
        "current_main_commit": CURRENT_MAIN, "previous_main_commit": old["main"],
        "current_main_recall_reachable_declarations_identical_to_previous_main": sorted(reachable),
        "current_main_recall_reachable_ast_sha256": d.sha(json.dumps(reachable, sort_keys=True).encode()),
        "current_main_import_declarations_identical_to_previous_main": True,
        "current_final_recall_reachable_declarations_identical_to_completed_source_bridge": sorted(previous_final),
        "current_final_recall_reachable_ast_sha256": d.sha(json.dumps(previous_final, sort_keys=True).encode()),
        "current_final_import_declarations_identical_to_completed_source_bridge": True,
        "completed_source_bridge_source_sha256": bridge_summary["source_sha256"]["final"],
        "source_sha256": {name: d.sha(content) for name, content in sources.items()},
    }


def initialize(output):
    global MODULES, PREFIX, RECALL, HELPERS, EXTRACT_OLD, EXTRACT_NEW, PROBE, OBSERVED_EXTRACT_NEW
    output = Path(output)
    MODULES, PREFIX, RECALL, HELPERS = {}, {}, {}, {}
    for name in ("main", "reviewed", "final"):
        module = d.load(f"r6_final_numeric_source_{name}", output / f"{name}-source.py")
        metadata = output / f"{name}-metadata.py"
        if metadata.exists():
            frozen = d.load(f"r6_final_numeric_metadata_{name}", metadata)
            for key, value in vars(frozen).items():
                if key.isupper():
                    setattr(module, key, value)
        original = getattr(module, "_without_us_manual_locators", lambda text, *, corpus_citation_path: text)

        @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128)
        def helper(body, citation, function=original, mode=name):
            masked = function(body, corpus_citation_path=citation)
            assert len(masked) == len(body)
            if mode == "final":
                assert function(masked, corpus_citation_path=citation) == masked
            digits = tuple(index for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(body, masked)) if before.isdigit() and before != after)
            return masked, digits

        HELPERS[name] = helper
        module._without_us_manual_locators = lambda text, *, corpus_citation_path, function=helper: function(text, corpus_citation_path)[0]
        generated, _ = d.split_function((output / f"{name}-source.py").read_bytes())
        exec(compile(generated, "<actual-source-prefix-and-suffix>", "exec"), vars(module))
        MODULES[name] = module
        PREFIX[name] = functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128)(lambda body, citation, target=module: target._audit_prefix(body, corpus_citation_path=citation))
        RECALL[name] = functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128)(lambda body, citation, target=module: target.authoritative_numeric_recall_text(body, corpus_citation_path=citation))
    old = d.load("axiom_encode.harness.r6_original_validator", output / "old-validator.py")
    new = d.load("axiom_encode.harness.r6_current_validator", output / "final-validator.py")
    proof = json.loads((output / "pipeline-proof.json").read_bytes())["numeric_extractor"]
    generated = (output / "candidate-probe.py.txt").read_text().rstrip("\n")
    assert proof["cleaning_prelude_old_new_ast_identical"] and d.sha(generated.encode()) == proof["exact_generated_candidate_probe_sha256"]
    exec(compile(generated, "<exact-unchanged-legacy-cleaning-prelude>", "exec"), vars(new))
    PROBE = functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128)(new._audit_legacy_condition_has_candidate)
    EXTRACT_OLD = functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128)(lambda text: tuple(dataclasses.asdict(item) for item in old.extract_typed_numeric_inventory_occurrences_from_text(text, profile="legacy")))
    EXTRACT_NEW = functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128)(lambda text: tuple(dataclasses.asdict(item) for item in new.extract_typed_numeric_inventory_occurrences_from_text(text, profile="legacy")))
    observer, observer_proof = make_observer((output / "old-validator.py").read_bytes(), (output / "final-validator.py").read_bytes())
    assert observer_proof == json.loads((output / "pipeline-proof.json").read_bytes())["guard_observer"]
    exec(compile(observer, "<pure-old-current-legacy-guard-observer>", "exec"), vars(new))
    @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128)
    def observed_inventory(text):
        tokenization, diverged = new._audit_legacy_tokenization_and_guard_divergence(text)
        return tuple(dataclasses.asdict(item) for item in tokenization.inventory), diverged
    OBSERVED_EXTRACT_NEW = observed_inventory
    d.EXTRACT = functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128)(lambda text, profile: tuple(dataclasses.asdict(item) for item in new.extract_typed_numeric_inventory_occurrences_from_text(text, profile=profile)))


def evaluate(task):
    file, line, raw, row, previous = task
    body, citation = row.get("body") or "", row["citation_path"]
    assert d.sha(raw) == previous["row_sha256"]
    masked, digits = HELPERS["final"](body, citation)
    prefix = PREFIX["final"](body, citation)
    main_prefix = PREFIX["main"](body, citation)
    main_helper, main_digits = HELPERS["main"](body, citation)
    assert d.sha(main_prefix.encode()) == previous["prefix_sha256"]["main"], "Current main raw prefix differs from authenticated old-main prefix"
    assert d.sha(main_helper.encode()) == previous["helper_sha256"]["main"], "Current main raw helper differs from authenticated old-main helper"
    assert d.sha(prefix.encode()) == previous["prefix_sha256"]["final"], "Final raw prefix changed"
    assert d.sha(masked.encode()) == previous["helper_sha256"]["final"], "Final raw helper changed"
    recalled = RECALL["final"](body, citation)
    assert recalled == MODULES["final"]._audit_suffix(prefix, citation)
    result = dict(previous)
    result.pop("seconds", None)
    result.pop("bridge_proof", None)
    result["final_fresh_prefix_sha256"] = d.sha(prefix.encode())
    result["current_main_fresh_prefix_sha256"] = d.sha(main_prefix.encode())
    result["current_main_fresh_helper_sha256"] = d.sha(main_helper.encode())
    result["final_fresh_recall_sha256"] = d.sha(recalled.encode())
    if "inventory_sha256" in previous:
        result["previous_inventory_sha256"] = previous["inventory_sha256"]
        result["inventory_sha256"] = {profile: dict(values) for profile, values in previous["inventory_sha256"].items()}
    result["recall_sha256"] = dict(previous.get("recall_sha256", {}), final=d.sha(recalled.encode()))
    result["helper_masked_digit_counts"] = dict(previous["helper_masked_digit_counts"], final=len(digits))
    candidate = PROBE(recalled)
    result["legacy_differing_grouped_decimal_candidate"] = candidate
    result["extractor_proof"] = "actual_old_and_current_legacy_extraction" if candidate else "fresh_exact_unchanged_prelude_no_differing_candidate"
    result["en_us_extractor_proof"] = "identical_reachable_profiled_route_ast"
    result["legacy_extractor_changed_inventory"] = False
    result["legacy_original_old_extraction_executed"] = False
    result["legacy_guard_decision_diverged"] = False
    if candidate:
        new_inventory, diverged = OBSERVED_EXTRACT_NEW(recalled)
        result["legacy_guard_decision_diverged"] = diverged
        result["legacy_original_old_extraction_executed"] = diverged
        if diverged:
            old_inventory = EXTRACT_OLD(recalled)
            result["extractor_proof"] = "observed_current_guard_divergence_and_actual_original_old_extraction"
        else:
            old_inventory = new_inventory
            result["extractor_proof"] = "fresh_current_legacy_extraction_and_inductive_no_guard_divergence"
        old_sha = d.sha(json.dumps(old_inventory, sort_keys=True).encode())
        new_sha = d.sha(json.dumps(new_inventory, sort_keys=True).encode())
        recorded = previous.get("inventory_sha256", {}).get("legacy", {}).get("final")
        if recorded:
            assert old_sha == recorded
        result["current_legacy_inventory_sha256"] = new_sha
        result["frozen_old_final_legacy_inventory_sha256"] = old_sha
        current_hashes = result.setdefault("inventory_sha256", {}).setdefault("legacy", {})
        current_hashes["final"] = new_sha
        for baseline in ("main", "reviewed"):
            if previous["prefix_sha256"][baseline] == previous["prefix_sha256"]["final"]:
                current_hashes[baseline] = old_sha
        change = d.delta(old_inventory, new_inventory, body, "legacy")
        if change:
            result["legacy_extractor_changed_inventory"] = True
            result["legacy_old_to_current_changes"] = change
            result["changes"] = dict(previous.get("changes", {}))
            for baseline in ("main", "reviewed"):
                if previous["prefix_sha256"][baseline] == previous["prefix_sha256"]["final"]:
                    baseline_inventory = old_inventory
                else:
                    baseline_prefix = PREFIX[baseline](body, citation)
                    assert d.sha(baseline_prefix.encode()) == previous["prefix_sha256"][baseline]
                    baseline_recall = RECALL[baseline](body, citation)
                    assert baseline_recall == MODULES[baseline]._audit_suffix(baseline_prefix, citation)
                    baseline_inventory = EXTRACT_OLD(baseline_recall)
                    current_hashes[baseline] = d.sha(json.dumps(baseline_inventory, sort_keys=True).encode())
                delta = d.delta(baseline_inventory, new_inventory, body, "legacy")
                key = f"{baseline}_to_final/legacy"
                if delta:
                    result["changes"][key] = delta
                else:
                    result["changes"].pop(key, None)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--previous", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, choices=(1, 2, 4), default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--resume", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    started = time.perf_counter()
    print(json.dumps({"stage": "read_verified_previous_evidence", "output": args.output.name}), flush=True)
    previous, output = args.previous.resolve(), args.output.resolve()
    assert previous.is_relative_to(d.HERE) and output.is_relative_to(d.HERE) and not output.exists()
    old = json.loads((previous / "summary.json").read_bytes())
    assert old["full_corpus"] and old["all_completion_guards_passed"]
    assert json.loads((previous / "verified-completion.json").read_bytes())["full_evidence_complete"]
    sources = {"main": d.git_bytes("show", f"{CURRENT_MAIN}:{d.SOURCE}"), "reviewed": (previous / "reviewed-source.py").read_bytes(), "final": (d.ROOT / d.SOURCE).read_bytes()}
    metadata = {"reviewed": (previous / "reviewed-metadata.py").read_bytes(), "final": (d.ROOT / d.METADATA).read_bytes()}
    assert d.sha(sources["final"]) == FINAL_SOURCE and d.sha(metadata["final"]) == FINAL_METADATA
    old_validator = d.git_bytes("show", f"{CURRENT_MAIN}:{d.VALIDATOR}")
    assert old_validator == d.git_bytes("show", f"{d.REVIEWED}:{d.VALIDATOR}")
    new_validator = (d.ROOT / d.VALIDATOR).read_bytes()
    assert d.sha(old_validator) == OLD_VALIDATOR and d.sha(new_validator) == NEW_VALIDATOR
    print(json.dumps({"stage": "numeric_ast_and_prelude_proof", "elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter()-started}), flush=True)
    numeric, generated = numeric_proof(old_validator, new_validator)
    observer, observer_proof = make_observer(old_validator, new_validator)
    print(json.dumps({"stage": "recall_pipeline_ast_proof", "elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter()-started}), flush=True)
    recall = current_source_proof(previous, sources, metadata)
    print(json.dumps({"stage": "authenticate_all_inputs", "elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter()-started}), flush=True)
    manifest = d.verified_manifest()
    old_rows = {}
    for line in (previous / "rows.jsonl").open():
        row = json.loads(line)
        key = row["file"], row["line"]
        assert key not in old_rows
        old_rows[key] = row
    assert len(old_rows) == 68848
    output.mkdir()
    for name, content in sources.items():
        (output / f"{name}-source.py").write_bytes(content)
    for name, content in metadata.items():
        (output / f"{name}-metadata.py").write_bytes(content)
    (output / "old-validator.py").write_bytes(old_validator)
    (output / "final-validator.py").write_bytes(new_validator)
    (output / "candidate-probe.py.txt").write_text(generated + "\n")
    (output / "guard-observer.py.txt").write_text(observer + "\n")
    (output / "pipeline-proof.json").write_text(json.dumps({"recall": recall, "numeric_extractor": numeric, "guard_observer": observer_proof}, indent=2) + "\n")
    names = ("changed_inventories", "new_demands", "removed_demands", "added_occurrences", "removed_occurrences", "added_typed", "removed_typed")
    metrics = {key: collections.Counter({name: 0 for name in names}) for key in old["comparisons"]}
    proofs, extractor_proofs, jurisdictions = collections.Counter(), collections.Counter(), collections.Counter()
    processed = candidate_rows = changed_extractor_rows = old_extraction_rows = 0
    seen, returned = set(), set()
    resumed_rows = []
    if args.resume:
        resume = args.resume.resolve()
        assert resume.is_relative_to(d.HERE)
        for name in ("main", "reviewed", "final"):
            assert (resume / f"{name}-source.py").read_bytes() == sources[name]
        for name in metadata:
            assert (resume / f"{name}-metadata.py").read_bytes() == metadata[name]
        assert (resume / "old-validator.py").read_bytes() == old_validator
        assert (resume / "final-validator.py").read_bytes() == new_validator
        for raw_line in (resume / "rows.jsonl").open():
            row = json.loads(raw_line)
            key = row["file"], row["line"]
            assert key in old_rows and key not in returned
            assert row["row_sha256"] == old_rows[key]["row_sha256"]
            assert row["final_fresh_prefix_sha256"] == old_rows[key]["prefix_sha256"]["final"]
            assert row["current_main_fresh_prefix_sha256"] == old_rows[key]["prefix_sha256"]["main"]
            assert row["current_main_fresh_helper_sha256"] == old_rows[key]["helper_sha256"]["main"]
            assert row["helper_sha256"]["final"] == old_rows[key]["helper_sha256"]["final"]
            returned.add(key)
            resumed_rows.append(row)
        print(json.dumps({"verified_partial_rows_to_resume": len(resumed_rows)}), flush=True)
    resumed_keys = set(returned)
    returned.clear()

    def tasks():
        for item in manifest:
            with (d.HERE / "input" / item["file"]).open("rb") as source:
                for index, line in enumerate(source, 1):
                    if not line.strip():
                        continue
                    if args.limit and len(seen) >= args.limit:
                        return
                    key = item["file"], index
                    assert key not in seen
                    seen.add(key)
                    if key in resumed_keys:
                        continue
                    raw = line.rstrip(b"\r\n")
                    yield item["file"], index, raw, json.loads(raw), old_rows[key]

    print(json.dumps({"started": True, "scope": "fresh_final_prefix_and_numeric_extractor_differential", "workers": args.workers, "limit": args.limit, "source_sha256": FINAL_SOURCE, "metadata_sha256": FINAL_METADATA, "old_validator_sha256": OLD_VALIDATOR, "validator_sha256": NEW_VALIDATOR}), flush=True)
    handles = {key: (output / f"changes-{key.replace('/', '-')}.jsonl").open("w") for key in metrics}
    try:
        with (output / "rows.jsonl").open("w") as rows, multiprocessing.Pool(args.workers, initialize, (str(output),)) as pool:
            import itertools
            for row in itertools.chain(resumed_rows, pool.imap_unordered(evaluate, tasks(), chunksize=1)):
                key = row["file"], row["line"]
                assert key not in returned
                returned.add(key)
                processed += 1
                candidate_rows += row["legacy_differing_grouped_decimal_candidate"]
                old_extraction_rows += row["legacy_original_old_extraction_executed"]
                changed_extractor_rows += row["legacy_extractor_changed_inventory"]
                proofs[row["proof"]] += 1
                extractor_proofs[row["extractor_proof"]] += 1
                jurisdictions[row["jurisdiction"]] += 1
                rows.write(json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
                for comparison, change in row.get("changes", {}).items():
                    handles[comparison].write(json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
                    count = metrics[comparison]
                    count["changed_inventories"] += 1
                    for name in ("new_demands", "removed_demands"):
                        count[name] += len(change[name])
                    for name in ("added_occurrences", "removed_occurrences"):
                        count[name] += sum(change[name].values())
                    for name in ("added_typed", "removed_typed"):
                        count[name] += sum(item["count"] for item in change[name])
                if processed % 500 == 0:
                    rows.flush()
                    for handle in handles.values():
                        handle.flush()
                    assert sum(path.stat().st_size for path in output.glob("*.jsonl")) < 1_000_000_000
                    print(f"{processed}/68848 rows; {candidate_rows} actual current legacy rows; {old_extraction_rows} original old executions; {changed_extractor_rows} changed extractor rows; {time.perf_counter()-started:.1f}s", flush=True)
    finally:
        for handle in handles.values():
            handle.close()
    expected = args.limit or 68848
    assert seen == returned and processed == expected
    assert not any(count["removed_demands"] or count["removed_occurrences"] or count["removed_typed"] for count in metrics.values())
    assert (d.ROOT / d.SOURCE).read_bytes() == sources["final"]
    assert (d.ROOT / d.METADATA).read_bytes() == metadata["final"]
    assert (d.ROOT / d.VALIDATOR).read_bytes() == new_validator
    assert d.verified_manifest() == manifest
    result = dict(old)
    result.update({"segmented_execution": {"preceding_incomplete_segment_rows": len(resumed_rows), "preceding_incomplete_segment_rows_sha256": d.sha((args.resume / "rows.jsonl").read_bytes()) if args.resume else None, "preceding_command_exit": "unobserved; machine restart interrupted" if resumed_rows else None, "fresh_remaining_rows": processed-len(resumed_rows), "preceding_source_metadata_validator_and_row_hashes_verified": True}, "main": CURRENT_MAIN, "previous_baseline_main_commit": old["main"], "scope": "fresh_final_prefix_and_numeric_extractor_differential", "rows": processed, "files": len({file for file, line in returned}), "full_corpus": not args.limit, "python": sys.version, "workers": args.workers, "threads": {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in old["threads"]}, "source_sha256": {name: d.sha(content) for name, content in sources.items()}, "metadata_sha256": {name: d.sha(content) for name, content in metadata.items()}, "validator_sha256": NEW_VALIDATOR, "baseline_validator_sha256": OLD_VALIDATOR, "comparisons": {key: dict(value) for key, value in metrics.items()}, "proof_counts": dict(proofs), "extractor_proof_counts": dict(extractor_proofs), "jurisdictions": dict(jurisdictions), "helper_final_length_passed_rows": processed, "helper_final_idempotence_passed_rows": processed, "all_completion_guards_passed": True, "fresh_final_prefix_helper_recall_and_legacy_candidate_checks": processed, "fresh_current_main_prefix_and_helper_equality_checks": processed, "fresh_current_legacy_extraction_rows": candidate_rows, "fresh_actual_old_and_current_legacy_extraction_rows": old_extraction_rows, "guard_observer_proof": observer_proof, "changed_legacy_extractor_inventory_rows": changed_extractor_rows, "previous_complete_summary_sha256": d.sha((previous / "summary.json").read_bytes()), "previous_complete_rows_sha256": d.sha((previous / "rows.jsonl").read_bytes()), "previous_complete_source_sha256": old["source_sha256"]["final"], "previous_complete_validator_sha256": old["validator_sha256"], "newly_masked_rows_vs_reviewed": 0, "newly_masked_digit_positions_vs_reviewed": 0, "runner_sha256": d.sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), "output_sha256": {path.name: d.sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in output.glob("*.jsonl")}, "elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter()-started, "limitations": "Fresh all-row current prefix/helper/recall and exact unchanged legacy cleaning-prelude candidate checks. Rows with no differing grouped/decimal candidate inherit original inventory deltas only after proof that the changed condition cannot apply; all possible candidates execute exact current legacy extraction with a pure old/current guard-decision observer. If any decision diverges, the original old extractor executes; otherwise induction proves identical old/current states and final inventory. Current main binds a freshly verified identical reachable recall AST and fresh all-row prefixes/helpers against the original main snapshot. en-US inherits through identical reachable profile-route AST. This is an explicit current-extractor differential, not another full three-snapshot extraction run."})
    (output / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
